title: Screen Measurement Instrument Quality
purpose: Screen a pinned corpus against a pluggable profile, direct internet lanes to collect criterion-bound evidence, verify it across vendors, and emit one screen table from which every view is rendered.

exit_codes.1: checks failed, input rejected, or refused
exit_codes.2: usage error: bad arguments, malformed argument value, or missing input file

output: Every verb prints exactly one canonical JSON document (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) to stdout.

verify.consumer_lane_class: internet, different vendor from the claim

global_options.--state DIR: state root; refused when inside this repository unless --allow-state-in-repo
global_options.--allow-state-in-repo: permit a state root inside the repository tree (tests, demos)
global_options.--now ISO8601: freeze the clock used for pinned_at, opened_at, recorded_at and ruled_at

lane_classes.offline_batch: deterministic, no internet, deferrable (LunaRoute GLM back lanes or any local driver)
lane_classes.internet: evidence collection and verification (Gemini, Codex); verification must come from a different vendor than the claim
lane_classes.chat_reasoning: attended drafting of ruling packets (Claude, Hermes)
lane_classes.human: rulings; only ids listed in humans

rules.R1: Criteria are data. Adding or removing a criterion never requires a code change.
rules.R2: Missing is not failing. Unknown contributes nothing, is reported as coverage, and widens the score range.
rules.R3: Stated restrictions outrank the score. A restricted item is never ranked above a clear item; an unknown restriction is flagged, not treated as a restriction.
rules.R4: Ties are kept. Competition ranking (1, 1, 3), no hidden tie-breaker, rank stability reported.
rules.R5: The corpus is pinned. Every run names a pin; pinned records are read-only.
rules.R6: Outside checks are appended, never overwritten. Outputs show pinned and observed values side by side.
rules.R7: Disagreements go to a human. Only a human ruling closes a conflict; models may draft packets.

state_layout.pins/: archived earlier pins and their records, never overwritten

ledger_format: JSON Lines, append-only, one canonical JSON object per line, no NaN or Infinity; IDs are content hashes so exact replays are idempotent and a conflicting replay under the same ID is refused.

emits.screen-table.csv: one row per item in rank order, restricted last
emits.screen-table.json: header (pin id, profile digest, ledger digests) and rows with ratings
emits.passports/<item>.md: per-item fields, ratings with evidence and grades, checks beside pinned values, conflicts, rulings
emits.linear-item.json: run summary for a driver to post
emits.export-manifest.json: sha256 of every written file plus pin id, profile digest and ledger digests

invariants: An absent or null field never fires a rule; unknown adds 0 to score and its weight to score_max.
A stated restriction is listed after every ranked row and is never ranked.
Equal scores (6 dp) share a rank; no tie-breaker is applied.
Pinned records are never edited; doctor detects a digest mismatch; re-pin with a different digest requires --new-pin and archives the old pin.
A claim counts toward a rating only if verified by a different vendor, matched exact or probable, relevance direct, credibility 1-3, and mapped to a level.
Verified claims that disagree with a pinned field leave the criterion conflicted until a human rules; they never override the pin alone.
No --out path may resolve inside a state root.
Brief priority is recomputed at render time and is never stored or hashed into brief_id.
Only a human id listed in humans can record a ruling.
No network call, no model call, no subprocess of user data; standard library only.
Export bytes depend only on state, profile and --as-of.
non_claims: Not an authority: a screen table ranks against the profile it was given, nothing more.
Provisional profiles are provisional; their weights are not the owner's method.
Does not browse, fetch or call models; it emits packets and ingests returns.
A passing test suite is not evidence that any real claim is true.
